name: smith behind neck press
description: On the smith machine, you press the bar overhead from behind your neck. Works the shoulders and triceps, so keep it controlled.
instructions: Place a bench inside the Smith machine and adjust the bar so you can sit with it just behind your head at upper-shoulder height.
Sit with your feet planted and take an overhand grip wider than shoulder width.
Unhook the bar without moving away from the fixed rails.
Press upward along the rails until your arms are nearly straight, then lower behind your head to a comfortable depth.
Keep your torso steady and rerack the bar after the set.
